crossRefs.note: All his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. He said, “For I will go down…
For I know that you will bring me to death, To the house appointed for all living.
Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”
The eye of him who sees me will see me no more. Your eyes will be on me, but I will not be.

translations.web: But now he is dead, why should I fast? Can I bring him back again? I will go to him, but he will not return to me.”
translations.bsb: But now that he is dead, why should I fast? Can I bring him back again? I will go to him, but he will not return to me.”
translations.kjv: But now he is dead, wherefore should I fast? can I bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he shall not return to me.
translations.asv: But now he is dead, wherefore should I fast? can I bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he will not return to me.
